preamble: No verified case of an aspirated bilabial stop [pʰ] becoming the palatalized [pʲ] has been found. The previous Slavic entry was unfounded: Proto-Slavic had no aspirated stops (Proto-Indo-European *bʰ had already merged with *b in Balto-Slavic), so the Slavic soft labials arose from plain *p before front vowels, which belongs under p_to_p_palatalized.

examples.from: plain *p before a front vowel (no aspirated stage)
examples.note: The soft labials of East Slavic derive from plain *p, not from an aspirate; the case is listed here only to document the misattribution.

sources: Schenker, A. M. (1995). The Dawn of Slavic: An Introduction to Slavic Philology. Yale University Press.
